Practical guide

Understanding Therapy Insurance Benefits

Coverage depends on the plan, clinician, service, network, and specific benefits.

Request appointmentVerify benefits

Start a benefits inquiry

Use Verify benefits to open an email to support@mft.care. Tell the support team you would like to begin a benefits check and ask how to provide the required information through the appropriate process. Leave insurance numbers and clinical details out of the initial email.

A general carrier name does not establish the benefits for your clinician, service, or particular plan. Verification is not a guarantee of payment.

Separate benefits questions from booking

The benefits button contacts the support team. The appointment button opens SimplePractice. Those are separate actions, so choose the one that matches what you are trying to do.

Couples consultations and couples sessions at M.F.T. are private pay. Confirm the intended appointment and fee rather than assuming an individual therapy benefit applies to couples work.

Keep a clear next question

Before requesting a time, ask what is known about the expected cost and what still needs confirmation. The clinician-selection and starting-care pages help you decide which appointment you are inquiring about.

This guide is not a benefit determination, a payment quote, or a replacement for your plan information.
